descriptor: Patient-data platform with a calm loading monitor

voice.summary: A monitor in a quiet ward: precise, level and never alarmed. Short phrases that tell the user the system is alive and working.
dos: Keep status lines literal, such as loading records
Use clinical terms correctly, such as bpm and trace
Reassure in as few words as possible

taglines: A steady beat while we load
Hold on, we have a pulse
boilerplate: Pulse Ledger is a patient-data platform with a monitor-style loader, designed to keep users calmly informed while records load. All data shown is fictional.

logo.note: A pulse line is literally the heartbeat trace the product is built on.
